Dominik "GruBy" Świderski (born February 28, 1995) is a Polish professional Counter-Strike 2 analyst and a former Counter-Strike 2 and Counter-Strike: Global Offensive player.

  • 2015-10-02 |  GruBy: osobiście obawiam się każdego [GruBy: I am personally afraid of everyone] by Maciej Petryszyn of Cybersport.pl
